rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.f7203_prorata_places: stock basis $10,000 against losses of $30,000; the project's six-place ratio 0.333333 gives $6,666.66 and $3,333.33, a column (c) total of $9,999.99 and $0.01 of basis left, where the model's exact ratio gives $10,000. The register's reading (decided under the owner's delegation of 2026-11-24) keeps the six-place ratio and caps each line within line 10, never above; a cent left by a ratio rounded down is accepted (it allows a cent less loss, so no tax is understated).
